assessment:
One tutor. Goblin Matron enters, you search for a Goblin card, it goes to your hand. That is the whole search half of this deck: no other card in the 99 reads "search your library". She left at v1.1.0 and came back at v1.1.1, and the pilot's reason is on record: Krenko, Mob Boss or Siege-Gang Commander, to hand, on a Goblin body.

Two things decide what you name. First, the fetch lands in your hand, so it still has to be cast: kicker gets paid, a counterspell gets its window, and a five-drop is a five-drop next turn. The goldfish's mean available mana is 3.087 on turn three, 3.932 on turn four and 4.657 on turn five, so Matron on three, Zada on four and the fetched card on five is the curve that fits, and under Goblin Warchief the fetched card costs {1} less. Second, Matron is herself a Goblin body: Krenko counts her, Skirk Prospector can eat her, and both logged losses came from keeping a hand with no small goblins. A turn-three Matron is a Goblin on the battlefield plus the Goblin you most need next.

Neither wish needs Zada. Of the passing stacks whose cards are still in the list, 001 and 003 put her on the board and 002 and 004 do not. Fetch for the swarm half and keep playing when she is answered.

Aim the wish at the group it can thicken. The early token maker group is drawn in 85.7% of games, 73.1% by turn six, mean turn 2.855, and every card in it that Matron can name is a Goblin. The storm half is out of reach: storm payoff plus ritual is drawn in 19.0% of games, 6.8% by turn six, and no Goblin tutor names a sorcery. The goldfish does not count Matron at all, so nothing in the figures here prices the wish; that is why the targets below are grounded in stacks, not in a rate.

targets.scenario: The default. Turn three, three Mountains, Goblin Instigator and its token on the battlefield, Zada in the command zone, no haste lord out. The table is developing and nobody has aimed a spell at you.
targets.why: Name Krenko. He costs {2}{R}{R}, or {1}{R}{R} under Goblin Warchief, and stack 004 counts what one activation does: five Goblins become ten, 13 power with haste under Warchief. Count your Goblins including Krenko himself; that is the number of tokens one tap makes. The goldfish averages 2.173 bodies on turn four and 3.046 on turn five, and Krenko doubles whatever you have each untap, which is why the pilot kept Matron for him. Turn four is the collision: Zada wants the same four mana. Cast Zada first if a cantrip is in hand (Zada online with a cantrip is 58.2% by turn six); cast Krenko first if the hand is bodies. Without a haste lord he taps on turn five, so a second Goblin Warchief or Goblin Chieftain on the board is the signal to fetch him early. He is an engine, not a loop: stack 004 refuted the combo-graph infinite for this deck. Feed Krenko to Skirk Prospector and he stays in the graveyard, because Zada is the commander and he is not. He is legendary, so Reflection of Kiki-Jiki cannot copy him; that is the Siege-Gang case.

targets.scenario: Behind. Your board was swept last turn. Five lands, Impact Tremors survived because it is an enchantment, Matron is the first play of the rebuild, and the seat that cast the sweeper has four mana open again. Assume a second sweeper.
targets.why: Rebuild with the card that is four bodies. The goldfish's mean board is 5.074 bodies on turn six and 7.244 on turn seven; one Siege-Gang is most of that from a single card. Every body is its own entry: stack 002 settled that each token entering is a separate Impact Tremors trigger (eight tokens, eight triggers, 8 damage to each opponent), so Siege-Gang and his three tokens are 4 to each opponent on arrival. Purphoros reads 2 for each other creature entering, 8 to each opponent off the same card; that turn has no stack yet, so count it on the oracle text and do not promise it. Against the second sweeper he answers himself: {1}{R}, sacrifice a Goblin, 2 damage to any target, so the tokens die on your terms in response. Cast him into an opponent who is tapped out, not into four open mana. If Fable has flipped, Reflection of Kiki-Jiki copies him every turn: a copy and three tokens, four arrivals a turn. He costs {3}{R}{R}, {2}{R}{R} under Goblin Warchief, so on five lands he is your whole next turn.

citations.quote: After the wrath, initiative goes to whoever rebuilds cheapest: redeploy worst-first, keeping the best threat in hand for their second sweeper.

targets.scenario: Closing. Seven Goblins on the battlefield, four of them made this turn and summoning sick, an opponent at 10 with one blocker, and {R}{R} spare after Matron resolves.
targets.why: Name him and pay the kicker: creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn. The four sick tokens attack now. This is the wish only a to-hand tutor grants, because kicker is paid as you cast the spell; a Bushwhacker put onto the battlefield is an unkicked 1/1. On the goldfish's 8.63 bodies at turn eight that is eight extra power, and the deck's median kill is turn eight (26.2% by turn seven, 56.9% by turn eight), so the job of this fetch is to pull that kill forward one turn by letting the turn's tokens swing. Goblin Chieftain does the same haste job for {1}{R}{R} and keeps it; Bushwhacker is {R}{R} and done. Count the damage before you name him: bodies plus one each, minus the blocker's absorb, against the life total.

citations.quote: You may pay an additional [cost] as you cast this spell.

targets.scenario: The one nobody sees coming. Turn six, four lands untapped, Krenko has untapped once and you have nine Goblin tokens, Impact Tremors on the battlefield, Empty the Warrens and Grapeshot in hand, no ritual drawn, and a seat with a sweeper deck holding up mana.
targets.why: Mana out of a creature tutor. Storm payoff plus ritual is drawn in 19.0% of games and 6.8% by turn six, so the storm turn is usually built without a ritual, and the board is the ritual. Prospector reads "Sacrifice a Goblin: Add {R}": a mana ability, so it never uses the stack and cannot be responded to, and you can activate it in the middle of paying for a spell. Stack 004 counts it: seven tokens into {R} seven times, gone at end of phase. The sequence on this board: Matron is spell one, Prospector for {R} is spell two, sacrifice tokens for the mana, Empty the Warrens is spell three with storm two, three resolutions, six tokens and 6 to each opponent through Impact Tremors (stack 002's cadence), then Grapeshot is spell four with storm three. Every token fed to Prospector is one fewer attacker and one fewer Impact Tremors body, so sacrifice the ones the sweeper would take anyway and keep the count on paper before the first activation.

citations.quote: An activated mana ability doesn’t go on the stack, so it can’t be targeted, countered, or otherwise responded to.
even if it’s in the middle of casting or resolving a spell or activating or resolving an ability.

tutors.notes: Once the search is done she is a 1/1 Goblin: Krenko counts her, Skirk Prospector eats her, Skullclamp on her draws two. She finds a Goblin card, so Siege-Gang Lieutenant is legal but only makes tokens while you control your commander; name him only with Zada on the battlefield. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker is not a legal name: its back face is a Goblin Shaman, but a double-faced card in your library has only its front face's characteristics (CR 712.8a), and the front is a Saga. Two names for a specific table: Goblin Trashmaster against an artifact seat, since the deck's only other artifact answer is Vandalblast, and Pashalik Mons before your own Blasphemous Act, so every Goblin that dies deals 1 damage to any target.

gaps:
Matron names Goblin cards and nothing else. Nothing in the deck finds Impact Tremors, Purphoros, Skullclamp, a ritual, a storm payoff or a Zada cantrip; those arrive when drawn. Storm payoff plus ritual is drawn in 19.0% of games, 6.8% by turn six, mean turn 6.849, and the tutor does not move that figure.

The goldfish does not see the wish at all. It models a cast tutor as a wildcard and excludes ETB tutors, so the assisted and unassisted figures are identical on every target (early token maker 85.7% and 85.7%). The value of naming Krenko or Siege-Gang is grounded in stacks 002 and 004 here, not in a rate.

A Purphoros turn, with or without Impact Tremors, has no passing stack; the 2-per-body arithmetic above is oracle text and needs a stack scenario. Stacks 002 and 003 predate v1.1.0; every card they use is still in the list, but the context flags them for a recheck.
